data.body: **[P2] Classify transport failures as fixture errors.** Botocore transport exceptions such as `ReadTimeoutError` bypass this handler. If one terminates the losing branch after `WINNER_READY`, the gate records `IO_INTERRUPTED` and `IO_EXIT` without `CONTROL_ERROR`. The existing SDK can then finish joining the failed branch within the grace period, and `early_completion()` accepts it as reclamation. Catch botocore transport exceptions, record them as infrastructure errors, and add a negative control injecting a transport failure after winner readiness.
